The 2026 Leadership Development Class Graduated!
Congratulations to all!
Focusing on our Core Value of Continuous Improvement,
Heartland Co-op has partnered
with Iowa Institute of Cooperatives
to work with a group of Heartland Co-op employees to prepare them for Leadership.
Celebrating our Interns
Intern Awards and Top Golf Day!
During the Interns time with Heartland, they participate in Heartland Insites
sharing what they have been learning or seeing in the field, it is then judged.
Awards are given out at the end of their time. We celebrated their hard work this week!
Congrats- Brady, Genevieve and Jacob!
We wish all our interns success in the future.
Announcement: Heartland Co-op Opening Texas Elevators
We are proud to announce that Heartland Co-op has opened elevators in Gruver June 13th and on June 15 opened Capps Switch, Texas. This further adds to our footprint in the Texas region.
We look forward to serving your area.
Questions?
806-733-5067
806-373-4388
Announcement: Heartland Co-op Acquires Legacy Propane
We are thrilled to share that Heartland Co-op has successfully acquired the propane business from Legacy Propane in the Allison, Iowa region.
This acquisition marks a significant milestone in Heartland Co-op's dedication to expanding our energy presence. We will strengthen our footprint in Butler County and nearby communities, all while maintaining the reliable service and local expertise that our customers have come to expect.
We eagerly anticipate the opportunity to serve our new customers in Allison.
Find out more about Propane services Heartland Co-op provides here:
Heartland Co-op Propane service in Allison, Iowa
